exposure: Timing of ovulation (ovulation 4.5 days vs. ovulation 5.0 days after ovulation)
cohort: This study included 67,018 cycles of frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer between January 2008 and December 2017 at Kato Ladies Clinic.
finding: Hormone replacement cycles were associated with a higher occurrence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, placenta accreta, cesarean delivery, preterm delivery, and low birthweight compared to natural cycles, while there was no significant difference in the risk of congenital anomalies.
